restrictions: Playing cards: one enhancement, one non-negative edition and one seal.
Jokers: edition and applicable stickers; no enhancement or seal.
Negative: Joker or specially generated consumable; no playing card.

before.editions: Four effects present; base is an extra state.
before.enhancements: Only Glass had a dedicated treatment.
before.seals: Four assets existed as standalone materials, not composited modifiers.

after.catalog: 16 entries in enhancement, edition and seal groups; original Simplified Chinese names.
after.composition: Three independent dimensions, valid targets and three presets.
after.rules: Visual only; full 16-modifier scoring and probabilities remain unimplemented.
after.gallery: Five Joker editions including Base; playing cards exclude Negative. Glass appears only as a playing-card enhancement.
after.visuals: Independent shared surface shaders matched to original Wiki references: concentric Foil, triangular Holographic, ink hue-shifting Polychrome, navy Negative. Previous floating projection is no longer loaded.

aliasPolicy: Legacy demo wording retained for search only; visible names use original Simplified Chinese localization.
